description: This Java class defines an Android IntentService named CalendarQueryService that queries calendar events and contact profile pictures, then sends the event data as DataItems to a connected wearable device using GoogleApiClient and the Wearable DataApi.

classes.name: CalendarQueryService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that queries calendar events and contact profile images, then communicates data to wearable devices.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient and connects to Google Play Services.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Executes the main logic: connects to GoogleApiClient, queries upcoming calendar events, and sends event data to wearables.

methods.name: queryEvents
methods.description: Queries calendar events within a specified timeframe and retrieves associated contact profile pictures.

methods.name: toPutDataMapRequest
methods.description: Converts an Event object into a PutDataMapRequest to be sent over the Wearable DataApi.

methods.name: getProfilePicture
methods.description: Retrieves a contact's profile picture or a default image if none exists.

methods.name: getDefaultProfile
methods.description: Returns a default profile Asset for contacts without profile pictures.

methods.name: toByteArray
methods.description: Converts a Bitmap object into a byte array.

methods.name: closeQuietly
methods.description: Closes a Closeable resource quietly, catching and logging IOException.
